name: Mid-infrared array dark and illuminated characterization on a 16 K bench
plain_name: Mid-infrared array dark and illuminated characterization on a 16 K bench
description: MITTEN's detector-characterization procedure uses a cold optical bench and internal Offner relay to evaluate dark/illuminated detector response; 16 K is the bench condition.

sources.citation: Bowens et al., The Michigan Infrared Test Thermal ELT N-band (MITTEN) Cryostat

requirements.rationale: The paper reports the optical bench at 16 K; detector temperature is separately controlled/not quantified here.
The reported controlled illumination uses the internal source/Offner relay.

missing_information: Detector operating temperature, read noise, dark current and source radiometry remain device-specific; no paper performance values are converted into guaranteed equipment specifications.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
